title: No Hatred, No Desire
devanagari: न मे द्वेषरागौ न मे लोभमोहौ
न धर्मो न चार्थो न कामो न मोक्ष-
iast: na me dveṣa-rāgau na me lobha-mohau
na dharmo na cārtho na kāmo na mokṣaś
translation: I have no hatred or attachment, no greed or delusion, no pride and no jealousy. I have no duty, wealth, desire or liberation: not even the four goals of life. My form is consciousness and bliss: I am Shiva, I am Shiva.
translation_hi: मुझमें न द्वेष है न राग, न लोभ न मोह, न मद है न मत्सर। मेरे लिए न धर्म है, न अर्थ, न काम, न मोक्ष। मेरा स्वरूप चेतना और आनंद है: मैं शिव हूँ, मैं शिव हूँ।
grammar: The six enemies: kāma, krodha, lobha, moha, mada, mātsarya (ṣaḍ-ripu). This verse lists most of them.
The four puruṣārthas: dharma, artha, kāma, mokṣa. Even the highest goal, mokṣa, is denied: the Self is already free.
Dual with -au: द्वेषरागौ, लोभमोहौ, nominative dual for pairs, like हरे गुरौ uses a locative.
